title: The problem of finding the global minimum of a polynomial on a coordinate parallelepiped
summary: The paper addresses the problem of finding the global minimum of a polynomial on a coordinate parallelepiped or on certain other sets with a simple structure. To solve the problem, the Variable Elimination Algorithm for polynomial optimization problems described in the author's previous works is used. It should be noted that the proposed method can be of practical significance only for problems of low dimensionality and for polynomials of not very high degree.
